its own DLQ + alarm:
malformed envelope, unkeyable url,
or a failed store write

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
hutch-inbox-saved-links (NEW)
PK userId, SK sha256(normalized url) — a sort key
caps at 1024 bytes, ESP wrappers exceed it
saved: unconditional upsert
failed: only if not already saved

(BatchGetItem only; no articles/user-articles)

span.p:
the card's Save button
saved: check icon + 'Saved'
unsaved / failed: 'Save to queue'
— still POSTs the same save route
